node.content-desc: Security & privacy notification: Set a screen lock

node.text: Save verified plain-JSON backups to Files, Drive, or removable storage. Retention and cleanup act only on Whip's automatic-backup and incomplete-write filenames.
A readable copy of your records and settings. Anyone with the file can read it.
Protect your records and settings with a passphrase. Whip cannot recover a forgotten passphrase.
Review a saved backup before choosing to merge or replace local data.
Export individual tables for spreadsheets. Use a backup to restore Whip.
